lead_raw_text:
The structure of V₆Si₄ (reduced formula V₃Si₂) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both environments: Si centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 V, 4 Si) at 2.365–2.492 Å, and V centers have 12 neighbors (6 Si, 6 V) at 2.383–2.539 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Si-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Si- and V-centered polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between V-centered polyhedra.
